summary: First Tracks Biotherapeutics filed an 8-K reporting the October 19, 2026 closing of a previously announced private placement of 6,106,870 common shares and entry into a registration rights agreement with the investors. The company must file or confidentially submit a resale registration statement within 30 days of closing; no price per share, premium, or valuation was disclosed in the excerpt. This is a routine financing and resale-rights arrangement, not a special situation, with overhang from resale registration the only angle to watch.
